pages.title: The Heavyweights
pages.text: A dino patty with cheese, tomato, and onion earns the name $(item)Mobzilla Burger$(). The $(item)Grilled Cheese$() asks only bread, cheese, and butter.

pages.title: Stacked High
pages.text: Shark steak on bread with greens and tomato — or go full club: peacock, bacon, the works.

pages.title: Crab Country
pages.text: The classic crabby patty, upgraded with cheese and onion until it deserves the word $(item)Deluxe$(). The $(item)Crab Roll$() is its handheld cousin.
